description: "G008 Retrofit HTTP client library — structure, build constraints, refactors done"
metadata:

Square's Retrofit HTTP client library (~200 main Java files, Gradle multi-module); unbuildable here without network deps. Core module at `retrofit/src/main/java/retrofit2/`.

**Key files:** `RequestFactory.java` (annotation parsing, `Builder` inner class), `ParameterHandler.java` (annotation handler hierarchy), `Utils.java` (reflection/type utilities), `OkHttpCall.java`, `HttpServiceMethod.java`.

**Refactor #1:** Extracted `Builder.parseStringHandler()` in `RequestFactory.java` — the identical Iterable/Array dispatch block (~20 lines each) was duplicated across `@Query`, `@QueryName`, `@Header`, and `@Field` annotation handlers. The helper takes a `Function<Converter<?, String>, ParameterHandler<?>>` factory lambda, handles the iterable/array wrapping internally, and uses `java.util.function.Function` (added to imports). Net: −63 lines.

**Refactor #2:** Extracted `Builder.validateStringKeyMap(p, type, annotationName)` in `RequestFactory.java` — the identical ~10-line Map validation block (check Map subtype, check ParameterizedType, check String key, return value type) was duplicated across `@QueryMap`, `@HeaderMap`, `@FieldMap`, and `@PartMap`. Minor: @HeaderMap error message changed from "Map or Headers" to "Map" (already handles Headers.class above). Net: −45 lines.

**Refactor #3:** Extracted `ParameterHandler.applyStringMap()` — `QueryMap.apply()` and `FieldMap.apply()` were structurally identical 30-line methods (null-map guard, per-entry null-key/null-value/null-conversion checks, builder call). The helper takes the map-name prefix for error messages and a `BiConsumer<String, String>` for the terminal builder action (`addQueryParam` vs `addFormField`). Minor: "Query map was null" gained a trailing period for consistency. Net: −22 lines.

**Refactor #4:** Extracted `Retrofit.missingFactoryException()` — `nextCallAdapter()`, `nextRequestBodyConverter()`, and `nextResponseBodyConverter()` each built the same ~11-line "Could not locate X for Y / Skipped: / Tried:" StringBuilder error. The helper takes (description, type, factories, start, showSkipped) and returns the `IllegalArgumentException`. Net: −23 lines across three methods.

**Refactor #5:** Extracted `Response.responseBuilder(int code, String message)` private static in `Response.java` — the four static factory methods (`success(T)`, `success(int, T)`, `success(T, Headers)`, `error(int, ResponseBody)`) all constructed identical `okhttp3.Response.Builder` chains (Protocol.HTTP_1_1, localhost Request) differing only in code and message. The helper returns a pre-configured builder; callers chain `.headers()` or `.body()` where needed before calling `.build()`. Net: −18 lines.

**Refactor #6:** Migrated `HeaderMap.apply()` in `ParameterHandler.java` to use `applyStringMap()` — `QueryMap` and `FieldMap` were already using `applyStringMap()`, but `HeaderMap` had a 19-line hand-rolled null-check + iteration loop. The lambda `(name, val) -> builder.addHeader(name, val, allowUnsafeNonAsciiValues)` captures the third arg via closure. Side effect: `HeaderMap` now also validates null converter output, making it consistent with `QueryMap`/`FieldMap`. Net: −15 lines.

**Refactor #7:** Extracted `CallCancelCompletableFuture` in `Java8CallAdapterFactory.java` (deprecated `retrofit-adapters/java8` module) — `BodyCallAdapter.adapt()` and `ResponseCallAdapter.adapt()` each created an anonymous `CompletableFuture` subclass with the same 9-line cancel-forwarding override. Extracted as a named `CallCancelCompletableFuture<T>` inner class, mirroring the identical extraction already present in `CompletableFutureCallAdapterFactory` in the core module. Net: −2 lines, significant readability gain.

**Refactor #8:** Extracted `createAdapter(Type, Annotation[])` in `MoshiConverterFactory.java` — both `responseBodyConverter()` and `requestBodyConverter()` obtained a `JsonAdapter` then applied the same three optional flag methods (`lenient`, `failOnUnknown`, `serializeNulls`) in identical 10-line blocks, differing only in which annotations array to pass. The helper consolidates adapter creation and flag application; callers pass the resolved adapter directly to the converter constructors. Net: −6 lines.

content.text: `WireConverterFactory.responseBodyConverter()` and `requestBodyConverter()` each duplicated an 8-line type-guard block — check `instanceof Class<?>`, check `Message.isAssignableFrom`, then call `ProtoAdapter.get()`. Extracted as a private `adapterFor(Type)` that returns the adapter or null; the two public methods now each reduce to a null-check guard plus a single converter construction line.
